verdict.rationale: Luma documents its own API, with generation endpoints, API key management, Python/JS/TS SDKs and production-grade dedicated throughput. That lets generation run programmatically without the browser UI, which covers the core of headless automation. However, nothing shows a CLI, CI integration guidance or a non-interactive workflow runner, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/pipeline usage, published OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration of automated use.
